entries.he: סְגֻלָּה לְחֳלִי הַצַּוָּאר, שֶׁיִּבְכֶּה עַל חֻרְבַּן בֵּית־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ.
entries.en: 9. It is a segulah for one suffering illness in the neck, to weep over the destruction of the Temple.
